# Caledonia Heating & Cooling

> From its base in Caledonia, Brant/Haldimand-Norfolk, Caledonia Heating & Cooling serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (905) 765-3418  |  Email: contact@caledoniaheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://caledoniaheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Caledonia, Brantford, Paris, Dunnville, Simcoe, Port Dover, Nanticoke, Ayr, Aylmer
